purpose: Ad-heavy corpus for Experiment B. The TAL corpus contains no third-party advertisements, so transcript-variant agreement on it measures intro/outro/house-promo placement only. These are well-known, heavily ad-supported shows whose enclosures are rendered by dynamic ad insertion.
selection: Per feed, the newest items by pubDate that have an audio enclosure, itunes:episodeType full (or no episodeType), and a declared itunes:duration of at least min_duration_seconds (or none declared); the measured ffprobe duration must also meet the minimum.
